title: Pork and Cabbage Potstickers
summary: Juicy pork and napa cabbage dumplings, crisp underneath and soft on top; freeze a batch.

steps.text: Soak {mushroom} in boiled water until soft, then squeeze dry and chop finely.
Squeeze the chopped {cabbage} hard in your hands to get rid of extra water.
Mix {list:cabbage,mushroom,pork,chives,soy,ginger,garlic,sesame} with your hands until well combined.
Wet half the edge of one of the {wrappers}, put a heaped teaspoon of filling in the middle, fold it over and pinch or pleat it shut.
steps.tip: Pleats are optional; a pressed seam works fine. Your toddler can press the edges.

steps.text: Keep the finished dumplings under a damp towel while you make the rest.
Heat 1 to 2 teaspoons of {oil} in a non-stick pan and fry 8 to 10 dumplings, flat side down, until golden underneath.
Pour in {water}, put the lid on straight away and steam until the filling is cooked through.
Take off the lid and cook until the water is gone and the bottoms crisp again. Repeat with the rest.

toddlerTips: Cut each dumpling in half or quarters so the steam escapes and pieces are bite-size.
For young toddlers, boil the dumplings instead of pan-frying for a softer wrapper.
Freeze uncooked dumplings on a tray, then bag; cook from frozen with a few extra minutes of steaming.
